Confirmatory refinement of the exp-20260601-007 incidental lead: a long-only top-quintile of 5-day-formation winners, held 10 trading days (skip-day), earns positive forward return IN EXCESS of the broad-universe equal-weight mean (long-only alpha), net of one round-trip cost (0.35pct), in a majority of the canonical 3 windows. The decisive NEW test is incrementality over core momentum: within ret20 (core-momentum proxy) quintile bands, the 5d-formation top-minus-bottom forward spread must survive (double-sort), otherwise the short-formation continuation is just the same momentum the core already trades. f5/h10 cell selection is inherited from exp-20260601-007 and carries its multiple-testing debt, so the per-day t-stat is reported but is NOT treated as independent confirmation; the ret20 double-sort is the load-bearing evidence.

Overnight vs intraday return decomposition on the broad 1446-ticker universe: the equity premium accrues mostly OVERNIGHT (prev_close -> open) while the intraday session (open -> close) is flat or negative (the overnight-return anomaly). Decomposing each ticker-days close-to-close return into overnight and intraday components and aggregating across the canonical 3 windows should show mean overnight return significantly positive (t>=2, majority windows) and materially larger than mean intraday return. This is a time-of-day structural mechanism orthogonal to the cross-sectional momentum that the prior ranking/reversal lines reduced to, and it has direct relevance to core entry/exit timing (the system enters at next-day open).
